ns2:section.sectionText: [Off-site] Location: Batey Urbano (front/computer lab section), 2620 W. Division Street, Chicago. The class will meet with the on-campus LIS 451AL1 lecture section from 6-8 p.m. (via interactive video) and Beth Ruane will conduct a lab session from 8-10 p.m. Open to LIS on-campus and LEEP students; non-LIS graduate students and juniors and seniors must have permission of instructor to enroll (eruane1@depaul.edu or mwolske@uiuc.edu). Required travel at mid-semester and near end of semester. Syllabus will have course and travel details. Additional $25 course fee (non-waived) will be assessed to student's bill. Registration is through Academic Outreach. Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science major(s).
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign Miscellaneous Fees $25.00 Flat Fee.
